2111096574948618293.text: Vertical integration, for us, is pretty concrete. We make Earth Cups in Kansas City, sell them on Earth Store, and run the company on software we own. In the last year we replaced over 10 third-party softwares, including HubSpot, Shopify, and others. More to come.

2113225001088278748.text: @mishavitels Really cool, how much money did you save on Hubspot and what were the main benefits?

2113226378623455456.text: @heykeithbrown Roughly $10k/month. It was important for us to cut out much of the HubSpot noise we didn't need and build custom sales workflows (pricing calculators, quotes, contracts) that connect directly to our production planner, SKUs, and IMS
